summary: Knight-Swift filed an 8-K on November 4, 2026, disclosing that its Board expanded by one seat and appointed Richard Howard, 61, as an independent director effective immediately, serving until the 2027 annual meeting. Howard, former President and CEO of Daimler Truck Financial Services USA, received 357 restricted shares plus standard director compensation and an indemnification agreement; no related-party transactions or side arrangements were noted. He joins the Finance and Nominating/Corporate Governance committees. The change is a routine board expansion rather than a forced or abrupt executive departure, so no deal mechanics or risk-arb angle apply.
